subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Please __consult__ a doctor before you take any medicine.
solution:
The correct answer is **'No improvement required'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is **grammatically correct.**
 
• We need to check whether the underlined segment is free from any **grammatical errors** or not.
 
• In this case, the word **'consult'** is grammatically correct and is in proper tense form.
 
• Therefore, no improvement is required in this case.
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 3.**
